scope: Strict typed Pydantic result contract, JSON Schema negotiation with explicitly capable providers, and bounded local output validation.

candidate.status: Integrated by non-force fast-forward at synchronized main 561185e3bd40e5a43a8092c7d00d99cf8804ab1f; issue #112 remains OPEN/PARTIAL after local evidence comment/readback.

acceptance.uses_typed_schema_validated_output: PASS - StrictAIResult uses Pydantic v2 strict validation, extra=forbid, typed models, and generated JSON Schema.
acceptance.offers_schema_only_to_explicit_structure: PASS - generate_structured requires exact structured_output capability and passes the model schema; text-only providers are rejected before generation.
acceptance.rejects_arbitrary_or_ambiguous_json: PASS - bounded JSON object only, duplicate keys and non-standard constants rejected, root and nested schemas must forbid undeclared fields, and Pydantic strict validation rejects coercion.
acceptance.safe_failure_behavior_and_disabled_defau: PASS - stable errors omit prompt/provider response details; disabled and unimplemented providers fail before network or generation.
acceptance.actual_remote_provider_and_production_ta: PARTIAL - no remote provider or production matching/task consumer is available, so live model behavior and end-to-end use are not established.
